extensionDescription.message: Review cookie banners, cookies, and traffic after a reject attempt.

legalDisclaimer.message: this is not legal advice. please still review the content. the creator takes no liability for the results.

popupIntro.message: See what the page does before and after a reject attempt.

scanStatusNeedsAccess.message: Page access is needed for a full scan.

scanStatusDeltaFound.message: Delta found in the current scan.

legendGreenBody.message: No obvious non-essential cookies or third-party traffic were found.

legendYellowBody.message: The situation is unclear or mixed.

legendRedBody.message: A non-essential tracker appears to run without consent.

legendBadgeNote.message: This status matches the badge in the extension bar.

cookiesTrafficIntro.message: This view groups visible cookies and local browser data. It updates after each scan.

storageOverview.message: Found local data: LocalStorage $1, SessionStorage $2, IndexedDB $3.

noLocalStorageVisible.message: No locally stored data was found for this tab.

deltaIntro.message: Compares the current state with a best-effort "deny all" state. CookieBuddy flags non-essential cookies and third-party requests that remain after opt-out.

helpIntro.message: CookieBuddy checks whether cookies or third-party requests still appear after you reject cookies.

helpStepBanner.message: It tries to recognize the cookie banner provider.

helpStepCookies.message: It lists visible cookies and likely services.

helpStepDelta.message: It compares what happens before and after opt-out.

helpStepReview.message: If something remains, treat it as a review signal, not as a final legal finding.

privacyIntro.message: CookieBuddy does not track you and does not send scan results to the creator or to any analytics service.

privacyLocalOnly.message: Scans run locally in your browser.

privacyStorage.message: The last scan is stored only in Chrome local extension storage on your device.

privacyNoAnalytics.message: There is no analytics, tracking pixel, remote logging, or account system.

privacyExternalLinks.message: External links and drafted emails only open when you click them; those external services have their own privacy rules.

openSourceIntro.message: CookieBuddy is intended to be open source. Contributions, bug reports, and banner-detection improvements are welcome.

bannerOverviewNotFound.message: No banner settings button was found.

bannerOverviewFailed.message: Could not open the banner overview on this page.

noCookiesVisible.message: No cookies visible to the extension for this tab.

cookiesTrafficEmptyState.message: No visible cookies or locally stored data were found for this page.

deltaCheckingDescription.message: Trying a deny-all action, then checking which cookies and network requests still happen. Essential infrastructure is separated from suspicious third-party traffic.

deltaConsentPrompt.message: CookieBuddy will try to click deny all. If you already declined manually, it will check the current post-opt-out state. Continue?

deltaConsentCancelled.message: Delta check cancelled. No changes were made.

deltaNeedsPageAccess.message: This page does not allow the delta check. Open a normal website and run the test there.

deltaNeedsManualConsent.message: I could not find a visible banner or deny option. Please decline all cookies manually first, then run the delta check again.

deltaCheckFailed.message: The delta check could not be completed.

deltaFoundSummary.message: CookieBuddy found non-essential cookies or third-party traffic after opt-out. This may mean data still flows without valid consent and should be reviewed.

noDeltaSummary.message: No obvious non-essential cookies or third-party traffic were found after opt-out in this browser session.

mailBody.message:
Hello,

I reviewed the consent behavior on $1 and would like to ask about cookies or third-party traffic after opt-out.

Kind regards

contactDraftHint.message: These buttons open a mail draft addressed to the company DPO. Please adjust the text before sending.

contactEditReminder.message: The sample texts are templates and should be adapted to the specific case before sending.

mailPersonalizeHint.message: Please review and fill in the marked details, the concrete context, and the personal data before sending.

accessMailBody.message: I hereby request information about the processing of my personal data by $1. In particular, please tell me which data is processed, for what purposes, on which legal basis, and to whom the data may be disclosed.

correctionMailSubject.message: Request to correct personal data at $1

deletionMailSubject.message: Request to delete personal data at $1

deletionMailBody.message: I hereby request deletion of my personal data at $1. Unless overriding retention obligations apply, please delete the following data or tell me which data is still stored: [please add the details].

deltaAuthorityMailIntro.message: I am contacting you regarding the cookie and consent behavior on your website:

deltaMailObservation.message: After selecting "reject all", "deny all", or a similar opt-out option in the cookie banner, I still observed cookies, browser storage entries, and/or third-party requests that may relate to analytics, marketing, social media, or other non-essential services.

deltaMailItemsIntro.message: The following items were observed after the opt-out attempt:

deltaMailBestEffort.message: The check was performed with a local browser tool and is only a best-effort technical observation. I understand that some cookies or requests may be technically necessary, and I would appreciate your clarification.

deltaMailQuestionNecessary.message: Which of the listed cookies, storage keys, and third-party requests are technically necessary?

deltaMailQuestionLegalBasis.message: Which legal basis you rely on for each remaining item after opt-out?

deltaMailQuestionOptionalActive.message: Whether any optional analytics, marketing, profiling, or third-party services are active before valid consent is given?

deltaMailQuestionWithdraw.message: How users can fully withdraw or refuse consent for optional processing?

deltaMailQuestionNotice.message: Whether the cookie banner and privacy notice accurately describe these remaining cookies, storage keys, and third-party services?

deltaMailBannerReference.message: For reference, the observed cookie banner was detected as:

deltaMailNoLegalClaim.message: Please treat this message as a request for clarification. It is not intended as a formal legal claim.

deltaReportMailBody.message:
Hello,

attached is the CookieBuddy audit report for our review of the cookie consent implementation on $1.

This report documents the results of our automated check. Please refer to the audit findings below for details about cookies and third-party traffic detected after consent was withdrawn.

Please provide clarification on the findings and the legal basis for any processing that was detected as continuing after consent was withdrawn.

Kind regards
